title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #3

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. The greeting "As-salamu alaykum" is a prayer for (1 mark)
   A. Peace
   B. Money
   C. Food
   D. Rain

2. Why should a Muslim not cheat in a game? (1 mark)
   A. Referees are strict
   B. Cheating is a Sunnah
   C. Cheating is fun
   D. Islam teaches honesty and fairness

3. The Prophet (S.A.W.) is reported to have raced with which wife? (1 mark)
   A. Hafsa (R.A.)
   B. Aisha (R.A.)
   C. Safiyya (R.A.)
   D. Khadija (R.A.)

4. What does the word "attribute" mean? (1 mark)
   A. A type of food
   B. A quality that describes someone
   C. A prayer
   D. A place

5. Who is a "babu"? (1 mark)
   A. Grandmother
   B. Aunt
   C. Cousin
   D. Grandfather

6. What was the first word revealed? (1 mark)
   A. Pray
   B. Iqra (Read)
   C. Fast
   D. Give

7. How much toothpaste should a child use? (1 mark)
   A. A whole handful
   B. None
   C. A full tube
   D. A pea-sized amount

8. Which is physical purity? (1 mark)
   A. Saying sorry
   B. Washing off urine from clothes
   C. Giving charity
   D. Removing envy from the heart

9. What should you do if a relative does not visit you? (1 mark)
   A. Insult them
   B. Ignore their events
   C. Never talk to them
   D. Still visit them kindly

10. Which prayer is right after sunset? (1 mark)
   A. Maghrib
   B. Asr
   C. Fajr
   D. Dhuhr

11. What does the Qur'an (9:40) mention about the Prophet and Abu Bakr? (1 mark)
   A. They were together in the cave
   B. They were in Habasha
   C. They were at Taif
   D. They were traders

12. How are the postures of swalah good for health? (1 mark)
   A. They harm the knees
   B. They stop movement
   C. They cause sickness
   D. They stretch and move the body

13. What did the Prophet do in the garden? (1 mark)
   A. Ate everything
   B. Made dua to Allah
   C. Fled to another land
   D. Cursed them

14. What did the Prophet say about modesty? (1 mark)
   A. It is weakness
   B. It is a game
   C. It is part of faith
   D. It is only for girls

15. Which is an example of respect? (1 mark)
   A. Ignoring
   B. Answering back
   C. Greeting parents with a smile
   D. Interrupting

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. What must a boy and what must a girl cover in prayer at the least? (3 marks)

17. Distinguish between physical and spiritual purity. (3 marks)

18. What lesson do we learn from Surah Al-Masad? (3 marks)

19. Describe how to clean a medium najasa on a mat. (3 marks)

20. Explain how the greeting "As-salamu alaykum" is connected to a name of Allah. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Peace
   It means "peace be upon you".

2. D — Islam teaches honesty and fairness
   Honesty applies in games too.

3. B — Aisha (R.A.)
   Reports say he raced Aisha.

4. B — A quality that describes someone
   An attribute is a quality, like kindness.

5. D — Grandfather
   Babu means grandfather.

6. B — Iqra (Read)
   Iqra means read.

7. D — A pea-sized amount
   A small amount is enough.

8. B — Washing off urine from clothes
   Physical purity concerns body, clothes and place.

9. D — Still visit them kindly
   Keep ties even if they do not.

10. A — Maghrib
   Maghrib is after sunset.

11. A — They were together in the cave
   The Qur'an mentions the two in the cave.

12. D — They stretch and move the body
   Regular movement keeps joints flexible.

13. B — Made dua to Allah
   He turned to Allah.

14. C — It is part of faith
   Recorded by Al-Bukhari and Muslim.

15. C — Greeting parents with a smile
   Respect is shown by manners.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: A boy must cover from the navel to the knees. A girl must cover the whole body except the face and hands.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the boy, 1 mark for the girl, 1 mark for the general rule of modest clothes.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Physical purity is cleaning body, clothes and place from najasaat. Spiritual purity is cleaning the heart from envy, pride and hatred.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for physical, 1 mark for spiritual, 1 mark for an example.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Wealth and family connections cannot save a person who refuses the truth and harms good people. We should avoid pride and harm.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for wealth cannot save, 1 mark for harming others is wrong, 1 mark for avoiding pride.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Remove the substance, pour water until the colour, smell and taste have gone, then dry.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for removal, 1 mark for washing until traces go, 1 mark for drying.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: As-Salam is Allah's name meaning the Source of Peace. The greeting is a prayer for peace and safety.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for As-Salam, 1 mark for meaning of the greeting, 1 mark for the link.
